run_evals_checkpoints: run evaluation jobs for model checkpoints on SLURM with configurable tasks, seeds, and parallelism
launch_slurm_job: launch a SLURM job from a bash sbatch script string and return the job ID
get_checkpoints_to_run: get checkpoints to evaluate and their remaining tasks from an S3 model directory
get_evaluated_tasks: get all tasks already evaluated for a given model name and checkpoint from S3 results
checkpoint_exists: check if evaluation results exist for a model checkpoint newer than a reference date
